entities.summary: Lean Bergmann is a German professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing with Eisbären Berlin in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). He has previously played with the San Jose Sharks in the National Hockey League (NHL). He also plays internationally for the German national team.
